content_status_meanings.used: Captured text has an explicit approved-CMS legacy URL link (and any supplied text hash matches).
content_status_meanings.seeded_for_review: A CMS seed references the legacy URL, but its review-gated status is not public usage or publication.
content_status_meanings.unused: Captured text has neither an explicit approved-CMS link nor a CMS seed source link.
content_status_meanings.robots: Capture respected robots.txt and did not fetch the legacy URL.
content_status_meanings.404: The capture request received HTTP 404; it is not content available for import.
content_status_meanings.unavailable: No usable captured content is available, including missing evidence or non-404 fetch failures.

safe_content_preservation_action.action: Create a review-only import queue from rows with content_status=unused, preserving the legacy URL and text_sha256 as provenance.
requires: A human reviewer must choose retain, rewrite, same-content redirect, or approved 410 for each unresolved legacy route.
Any import must store the legacy URL and captured text_sha256, then remain draft/review-gated until approved.
Robots-disallowed and 404 rows need a route decision, not a raw-content import.
must_not: Do not publish raw extracted text.
Do not treat cms_seed source_imported_review_required records as public content.
Do not use homepage or search-page redirects as a fallback for unresolved URLs.
